pe_assessment: Snapshot trailing/forward P/E 21.68/13.29; inference: attractive against observed growth, subject to estimate durability.

debt_analysis: Cash $3.053bn against $3.515bn debt: derived net debt $0.462bn. Q2 FCF $0.863bn covers financing needs, although receivables increased.
growth_outlook: Q3 revenue guidance $2.055–2.085bn is prospective; current growth and profitability support a positive thesis.
key_strengths: Small net debt relative to cash generation
summary: Operating growth, high margins and limited net leverage support buy at the frozen forward multiple. Confidence remains medium because advertising economics and cash conversion can change.
